scope: All36 actual returns inspected across nine source/white/cyan/alpha pages, three native sheets, nine candidate boards and ten targeted complete raw views.28 actual passes,8 source-bound art failures. No service refusal in this original batch. Matching larger Fazlul Huq has bare eyes; original eye/brow contours in Innitzer and Deveze do not reliably establish independent separate rims/bridge, so no forced glasses edits. Borms actual pointed compact chin-beard shape is retained rather than expanded from jaw shading. Huysmans cropped compact dark neckwear does not reliably prove a bow tie, so no speculative swap. Verstraete larger candidate has different cap/pose/accessories and is not substituted; the small cap-edge pale area does not establish a missing white plume. Likewise Leopold larger candidate has different head direction: only exact small native neck shapes justify removing invented printed cloth/diamond, without importing unshown ranks or badges. Canonical output-SHA/attempt decisions determine qualification.
